notes.title: Help shape the future of Naught Bots!
notes.notes:
Hello,

My name is JT Mitchell, and I just wanted to say, thank you for making Naught Bots one of my most popular games to date!  With well over 7,000 players!  To show my appreciation I plan on continuing to support Naught Bots with more updates over time and I wanted to reach out to the community for feedback on what you would like to see.

I have put together a short survey for the community to fill out and would greatly appreciate your responses.  As a bonus, a few lucky submissions can look for a free copy of my latest project Cat Capacity in their emails.  

[b]The Survey:[/b]  https://bn2i2m947eb.typeform.com/to/FqCN8nJu

[b]Check out my latest project Cat Capacity:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1758640/Cat_Capacity/

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]

In case you missed the last announcement here is the rough breakdown of the new abilities and powerups!  I will be making them a bit clearer in the next update but until then here they are!


[b]NEW ABILITIES:[/b]
[b]DASH[/b] (left shift when charged), zip across the map like a gazelle...bot bounding over blood-curdling crevasses and hoards of those smerking Naught Bot fiends. Grants increased speed, jump height, and jump control.
[b]GLITCH BOOST[/b] (left shift when charged), save up 3 Dash's and you get a Glitch Boost. Smash right through hoards of enemies and get HP while you do it! Grants temporary invulnerability, HP/bot smashed, increased speed, jump height, and jump control.

[b]NEW POWER-UPS:[/b]
[b]BOMB[/b] (Right-click, G, or Q, when charged), blow up groups of enemies in one shot. Recharges after time.
[b]CLOCK[/b], grab floating purple clocks to get 100 points and slow down the Naught Bot Network Virus Detection that's hunting for you

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: FASTER AND MORE DANGEROUS...ER 1.3B
notes.notes:
NEW UPDATE - FASTER AND MORE DANGEROUS...ER:

NEW ABILITIES:
[list]
[*] DASH (left shift when charged), zip across the map like a gazelle...bot bounding over blood-curdling crevasses and hoards of those smerking Naught Bot fiends.  Grants increased speed, jump height, and jump control.
[*] GLITCH BOOST (left shift when charged), save up 3 Dash's and you get a Glitch Boost.  Smash right through hoards of enemies and get HP while you do it!  Grants temporary invulnerability, HP/bot smashed, increased speed, jump height, and jump control.
[/list]
NEW POWER-UPS:
[list]
[*] BOMB (Right-click, G, or Q, when charged), blow up groups of enemies in one shot.  Recharges after time.
[*] CLOCK, grab floating purple clocks to get 100 points and slows down the Naught Bot Network Virus Detection that's hunting for you.
[/list]
NEW ENEMIES:
[list]
[*] BIG CHONGA BOTS, BIGGER, slower, and more dangerous...er.  These big damage sponges may move slow but watch out they deal double damage when they catch you.  Big Chonga's are worth 50 points each.
[*] ZIPPY BOTS, aww they just want hugs UWU.  Watch out these tiny little guys move super quick.  They deal less damage and take less damage than their larger bot friends.  Zippy bots are worth 30 points each.
[/list]
NEW FEATURE:
[list]
[*] VIRUS DETECTION (top left in GUI), in Naught Bots you play as a virus determined to take down the Naught Bot Network Virus...A VIRUS AGAINST A VIRUS!!!  And the Naught Bot Network is looking for you.  VIRUS DETECTED, once the virus detection system finds you watch out, the number of bots doubles and they move twice as fast!  Grab the purple clocks to slow the detection system down.
[/list]
NEW VOICE ACTING:
[list]
[*] Zak Trapp, BIG shout out to Zak Trapp for doing some great voice acting work for this update! 
https://www.twitch.tv/zaktrapp
[*] RanchStandUpStraight, Also shout out to RanchStandUpStraight for a brief but memorable cameo! 
 https://www.twitch.tv/ranchstandupstraight
[/list]
NEW LOOK:
[list]
[*] New player texture.
[*] New level texture.
[*] New UI.
[/list]
LOTS OF BALANCING:
[list]
[*] HP now does more!  HP recharges when below a certain amount.
[*] When the player is hurt they get a speed boost.
[*] Decreased number of waves to 16.  You can now beat the game in under 30 minutes.  "my fastest time is 26 minutes, can you beat it?" - JT Mitchell (Solo Naught Bots Dev)
[*] And lots more!
[/list]
